column3: The explicit fullness of noise is condensed into commotion.
“Fugitives” replaces those found in the city.
“Walls” and “mountains” are plural instead of singular.
The men accompanying the chariotry are not separately expressed.
“Gates” is plural instead of one gate.
“Who authorized you” replaces “whom do you have here.”
The change from “I” to “he” is rendered passively.
